input.standard: ASTM E741 (tracer gas concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the served volume V_lab of the Lab (m3) from the CO2 decay time constant, V = Qe * tau, with a gentler and shorter rise than decay-vlab-lab-01.

steps.why: Rise: reduced scrubber speed (datasheet minimum elevated speed) so the Lab CO2 climbs slowly; shortened from the 12+ min of the aborted test.
Decay: full speed, about one time constant (tau = V/Qe ~ 30 min for a first guess of 30 m3 and Qe = 1 m3/min); recorded every minute.

abort.when: CO2 at or above limits.co2AbortPpm (2400 ppm)
cdr or fe-3 out of the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring lost, or one more person in the Lab
the device refuses a step's command
battery state of charge under 40 percent

monitoring.reason: Both Lab occupants breathe the raised CO2; cdr left the band in the previous test, so both are watched from the start, band not widened.

hypotheses: Lab is one well-mixed zone; the hatch to Hab-B stays closed throughout and the exchange through the closed hatch is not measured (design flow 3 m3/min is only the open/ventilation figure), so it is a hypothesis, not zero.
Two occupants at constant awake activity (~0.38 L/min CO2 each) for the whole test; nobody enters or leaves.
Qe = 1 m3/min at full speed from the datasheet (3.3 m3/min x 0.3); scrubber lag 3.33 min is short against tau and is excluded from the fit start.
First guess V = 30 m3 (default) is only used to size durations; V_lab is the result of the fit, not of this guess.
Hab-B CO2 (co2-2) is recorded to show whether the closed hatch exchanges air.

expected.rise: From 950 ppm, at 40% (Qe 0.4 m3/min) the equilibrium is ~1900 ppm with tau ~75 min; in 10 min CO2 should rise only modestly (~100-150 ppm, to ~1050-1100 ppm), well under 2000 ppm. If CO2 exceeds 2000 ppm the source or V is far off the hypotheses.
expected.decay: At 100% the equilibrium is ~760 ppm (G/Qe) with tau ~30 min if V is 30 m3; fit C(t)=C_eq+(C0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau) and V = 1 m3/min x tau. A fitted tau far from 30 min gives V different from 30 m3; a C_eq far from ~760 ppm or Hab-B CO2 following the Lab would show exchange through the hatch or a wrong source.
expected.people: CDR and FE-3 heart rates stay in 45-120 bpm; any breach stops the test. The rise is small, so the signal-to-noise of the fit may be limited: a rise under a few hundred ppm would be reported as such, not compensated by a deeper rise.
